description: Header file defining the HpackDecoder class for decoding HPACK blocks in HTTP/2, including methods for setting string size limits, applying header table size settings, starting, decoding, and ending decoding of HPACK blocks, and error handling.

classes.name: HpackDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding HPACK blocks in HTTP/2, managing decoder state, error handling, and listener notifications.

methods.name: set_max_string_size_bytes
methods.description: Sets the maximum size of strings accepted in HPACK decoding to prevent OOM attacks.

methods.name: ApplyHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Updates the header table size setting based on SETTINGS ACK frames.

methods.name: GetCurrentHeaderTableSizeSetting
methods.description: Returns the current header table size setting.

methods.name: StartDecodingBlock
methods.description: Prepares the decoder to start decoding a new HPACK block.

methods.name: DecodeFragment
methods.description: Decodes a fragment of an HPACK block, reporting header entries to the listener.

methods.name: EndDecodingBlock
methods.description: Finalizes decoding of an HPACK block, indicating completion.

methods.name: DetectError
methods.description: Checks for errors in the decoding process.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the current error state of the decoder.

methods.name: detailed_error
methods.description: Returns detailed error message if any.
